description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walaswewa, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310085
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral map references, and ownership details) in Walaswewa village, which falls under the definition of land and property-related matters. The content focuses on land title settlement and registration without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
